title: Runbooks
html:
This directory contains the authoring policy, template, local instructions, and the production procedures for the single-host deployment of ADR-0031. They are drafts: every command is exercised by the disposable installation rehearsal in CI, and none has run on the production host yet.

Procedure Use when
Production host setup and first deployment Preparing a host and running the first release
Production release update and rollback Installing a newer release or returning to an earlier one
Production backup and restore Taking, verifying or restoring database backups
Production secret rotation Replacing a credential or key

The files these procedures run are described in infra/production. Add index entries only for real procedures when the corresponding runtime and operational tooling exist.

Existing contributor procedures have narrower owners: local setup, validation, and database release/evolution.

Runbooks describe current repeatable operations, not hypothetical systems or historical incident narratives. A procedure does not grant authority: production access and incident response continue to apply.

Create a procedure

Read the authoring policy, choose one real condition, and copy the template. Identify ownership, triggers, required access, verifiable preconditions, bounded diagnosis/actions, recovery verification, and stop/escalation conditions. Do not invent provider commands.

Find related policy

  • Health checks and observability for diagnostic evidence.
  • Alerting for actionable signals and runbook references.
  • Secrets, classification, and retention for safe handling of credentials, evidence, and temporary exports.
  • Documentation task index for other current policies.
